description: Fork of exp328 (vanilla MinimalGPT+RoPE, bs=16, 8K, tied tok_emb<->head, 1.3882 @ 23.21M). SINGLE change: UNTIE the token embedding and output head (remove self.head.weight=self.tok_emb.weight) so they are separate matrices, each normal(0,0.02). Adds vocab*n_embd=32768*384=12.58M -> ~35.79M total. Measures how much tying-vs-untying affects validation bpb. Everything else identical to exp328 (seed 1, lr 3e-4, wd 0.1, bf16).
